definitions.activeContributor: A unique, identifiable, non-bot GitHub commit author or merged-pull-request author active during the trailing six months across any included ecosystem repository.
definitions.activeRepository: An included repository with a default-branch commit or merged pull request during the trailing six months.
definitions.allTimeContributor: A unique, identifiable, non-bot GitHub commit author or merged-pull-request author across the current included repository set.
definitions.includedRepository: A public, non-fork, non-archived repository with verified Hoon language evidence, plus approved core exceptions.
